originalProposals.reason: Water drops bead from surface tension, but no current core facet teaches surface tension. G7-M-3 requires particle motion/spaces/attraction/temperature and is not even admitted; G5-M-3 needs definite/indefinite shape and volume of solids, liquids, and gases, not drop geometry. All candidates are keyword swallows (water, pull, round, surface). Potential new surface-tension/cohesion facet, or G7-M-3 after an attraction-at-the-surface teaching.

Pepper-scatter soap demo of weakened surface tension. G7-M-3 (particle motion/spaces/attraction/heat) is not admitted and is not taught. G5-F-2 is a friction-surface investigation, not surface tension. G7-E-9:reflect-scatter matches scatter but is sunlight in the atmosphere. Potential G7-M-3 after intermolecular-attraction/surface-tension, or a dedicated surface-tension demo facet.

Soap/detergent lowering surface tension so soapy water spreads and cleans. G5-M-3 is shape/volume of states, not surface tension. G6-M-4 is uniform/non-uniform mixtures, not surfactant action. G5-F-3:reducing-friction matches reduc but is oil/lubrication, not soap-on-water. G3-L-8:care-actions matches clean as environment-care, not cleaning chemistry. Potential G6-M-4 after soapy-water-as-mixture, or a surfactant/surface-tension facet.

Water striders and needles float on surface tension because water molecules cling at the surface. G7-M-3 is not admitted and does not get a particle-model teaching; G7-M-2:particles matches molecule but is the particle model of matter, not floating-on-a-skin. G5-L-4:insects is a classification table, not insect locomotion. Potential G7-M-3 after attraction, or a surface-tension/density-buoyancy facet.

Water spreads on paper/glass because it clings to the surface more than to itself (adhesion vs cohesion). G7-M-3 related_only and not admitted; G5-M-3 is states' shape/volume; G5-F-2 is friction surfaces. Potential adhesion/cohesion facet, or G7-M-3 after particle attraction.

Swallow body streamlined to slip through air. G5-L-9 admits only camouflage/mimicry, not streamlining. G4-L-3 requires a drawing/diagram classifying terrestrial/aquatic/aerial and is not satisfied. G3-L-4 outer-parts-to-move is not admitted (no head/legs/wings role). G5-L-6:birds is life-cycle, not body shape. Potential G5-L-9 after a streamlining/adaptation example, or G3-L-4 after body-shape-for-flight.

Sweat tastes salty because it carries body salt/minerals, so heavy sweating needs salt replacement. G8-L-2 needs models/diagrams of systems working together (digestion/excretion). G10-L-1 homeostasis indicators are temperature/glucose/blood pressure, not electrolyte loss. G6-M-7:products matches salt as a separated product. Potential excretion/electrolyte or G10-L-1 after a salt-balance indicator.

Hardened swiftlet saliva glues nest and eggs to a cave wall. G3-L-4 is outer parts for movement/feeding, not saliva. G5-L-9 is camouflage/mimicry. G8-L-1:secretion is digestive saliva/enzymes, not nest cement. G5-L-5:egg-laying needs bird.*egg as reproduction-mode grouping, not nest adhesion. Potential G5-L-9 after nest-glue adaptation, or G8-L-1 after non-digestive saliva.

Swiftlets nest in the darkest cave interiors with almost no light. G4-L-3 needs a habitat-classification diagram (terrestrial/aquatic/aerial). G4-L-4 needs a list/table of organisms in a named habitat. G3-L-6 never identifies shelter as a basic need. G6-L-8:nonliving-interactions matches light but does not explain good/harm. Potential G4-L-3 after cave/aerial classification, or G6-L-8 after light-as-abiotic effect.

Swifts eat airborne insects and spiders. G4-L-6 needs grouping herbivore/carnivore/omnivore from secondary sources; a single diet fact is not that skill. G5-L-4:insects is a classification table, not a food item. Potential G4-L-6 after naming swifts as carnivores.

Higher release makes a pendulum swing farther/wider. G8-F-4/F-5 need named kinetic/potential energy and PE↔KE examples; the card never names energy. G4-F-5 (pushes/pulls changing speed/direction) is not admitted. G3-F-1:pull is ways to make objects move, not amplitude. Potential G8-F-4/F-5 after naming PE/KE, or G4-F-5 after a guided pull-to-change-motion activity.

Shorter pendulum string swings faster; longer swings slower. G4-F-2 is measuring distance/time with equipment. G4-F-3 defines speed as distance/time. G4-F-4 is constructing speed graphs. G4-F-5:faster and G4-F-5:slow-stop would both admit (faster/slowly) without teaching pushes/pulls. G4-E-8:length is shadow-stick length. Potential G4-F-3 after period-as-speed, or a pendulum-period facet.

Calcium influx at a neuron tip triggers vesicle release of a chemical messenger. No nervous-system core at grades 3–10. G7-L-8 needs a labelled diagram of cells-to-biosphere. G7-L-2 is microscope cell-part technique. G8-M-6:next-ten matches calcium as an element name, not synaptic calcium. Potential new synapse/neuron facet (same gap as neuron-electric-chemical holds).

Taal as a lake on Volcano Island inside Taal Lake (island-in-a-lake). G5-E-1 requires identifying landforms/water bodies AND how they influence living/non-living components; the card is geographic trivia with no influence. G6-E-3 is 100-year Philippine eruption-history patterns (Mayon/Taal/Pinatubo/Kanlaon), not island-in-lake geometry. Potential G5-E-1 after an influence clause, or G6-E-2 after local-volcano-risk.

Taal looks small but is highly dangerous because it sits in a lake. G6-E-2 needs nearest active/inactive volcanoes and community-risk assessment, not a single celebrity-volcano fact. 'Because it sits in a lake' also oversimplifies Taal's hazard (explosive history, nearby population, phreatic/base-surge potential). G6-E-3 is eruption-history patterns. Potential G6-E-2 after local-risk wording.

Taal sits inside a lake, a volcano-within-a-lake geographic fact. G6-E-2 and G5-E-1 are related_only: no nearest-volcano risk assessment and no influence on living/non-living components. G6-E-3 is eruption history. Potential G5-E-1 after influence, or G6-E-2 after local risk.

Sucrose is table sugar made of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen. G8-M-4 needs properties of pure substances (fixed composition, elements vs compounds, unique proton number), not a composition list. G8-M-6:first-ten matches C/H/O as element names but the card does not teach names/symbols of the first 20 elements. G6-M-5:oxygen is air-as-mixture. Potential G8-M-4 after compound-composition, or G8-M-6 after naming C/H/O as elements.

Tabon Man remains in Palawan dated ~22,000–47,000 years as early Philippine humans. G9-E-5 is relative/absolute dating techniques for geologic-time subdivisions; the card states an age, not a method. G9-E-4 is using fossils to date rocks/sediments, not human archaeology. G4-L-5:human is life-cycle (baby/adult teeth). Potential G9-E-4/E-5 after dating-technique teaching, or a Philippine human-fossil enrichment.

Many tagak (egrets) have white feathers that stand out in green rice fields. G3-L-4 mentions feathers only if they serve movement/feeding; visibility is not that role. G5-L-4:birds (feather) is a classification table, not color trivia. G4-L-4:rice-field needs a list/table of habitat organisms. G5-L-9 camouflage/mimicry is not admitted (white that stands out is the opposite of camouflage). Potential G3-L-4 after feathers-as-body-part, or G4-L-4 after a rice-field example list.

Talahib leaf edges are sharp and can cut skin. G5-L-7 specialized structures lists rhizomes/tubers/thorns/bulbs/aerial roots — not sharp leaf margins — and the card never states a plant-defense purpose. G3-L-5 is leaves getting water/nutrients. G3-M-7:handling is proper handling/disposal of materials (sharp/broken glass), not wild-grass cuts. Potential G5-L-7 after a sharp-leaf/thorns-defense example.

Talinum is an easy backyard leafy vegetable and a source of iron/nutrients. G3-L-6 never identifies food as a basic need. G3-L-5/G4-L-2 do not observe leaf/root/shoot roles. G3-M-9:iron and G6-M-7:products match dietary iron as a metal/separated product. Potential nutrition/food-plant facet, or G3-L-6 after food-as-need.

Titan arum inflorescence >3 m and smells like rotting meat. G5-L-7 is rhizomes/tubers/thorns/bulbs/aerial roots, not inflorescence height. G3-L-5 is outer parts for water/nutrients. G10-M-1:odor is a chemical-reaction indicator. Trivia, not a current core teaching. Potential G5-L-7 after specialized reproductive structures.

Tamaraw once roamed all Mindoro and were almost wiped out in ~100 years. G9-L-6 requires classifying as critically endangered/endangered/vulnerable from secondary sources; the card never uses those IUCN labels (and G9-L-6:focus-1 critically endangered is not admitted). G9-L-7 needs a class discussion of how threats cause extinction, not a decline narrative. G3-L-8 never states a need to protect/conserve. Potential G9-L-6 after IUCN classification, or G9-L-7 after hunting/habitat threats.

Tamaraw is a smaller wild buffalo than the common carabao ('dwarf buffalo'). App vs merged copy differs by a subject NP ('It's a kind' vs 'The tamaraw is a kind') with the same meaning — noted, not recovered. G5-L-4 needs a classification table of living-thing groups. G5-L-6:mammals is life-cycle (calf/carabao). G6-L-4:local matches carabao but is vertebrate vs invertebrate. G9-E-9:dwarf is a stellar/galaxy dwarf, different referent. Potential G6-L-4 after a tamaraw vertebrate example, or G5-L-4 after mammal classification.

Tamaraw as the largest native land animal found only in the Philippines. G4-L-4 needs a list/table of organisms in a named habitat. G9-L-6 needs IUCN status, not endemism/size. G4-L-3:land is a habitat-classification diagram. G6-L-4:local matches Philippin but is backbone vs no backbone. Potential G9-L-6 after critically-endangered classification, or G4-L-3 after terrestrial classification with a diagram.

Solitary living is the tamaraw's natural way and helps keep it safe in the forest. G5-L-9 admits only camouflage/mimicry, not solitary behavior. G3-L-8:protect-habitats matches forest but is a need to protect/conserve habitats, not an animal's safety strategy. G4-E-6:safety is weather-chart precautions. Potential G5-L-9 after behavioral adaptation, or G6-L-6 after a living-interaction.

Unlike herding carabao, tamaraw live alone because hiding in thick grass is safer. G5-L-9 is camouflage/mimicry, not solitary hiding. G5-L-6:mammals/comparison is life-cycle comparison, not social behavior (unlike matches the comparison facet without teaching life cycles). G6-L-4:local is vertebrate/invertebrate. Potential G5-L-9 after behavioral adaptation, or G6-L-6 after competition/predation context.

Tamilok coats its wood tunnel with a thick white chalky lining. G4-L-3 needs a habitat diagram. G5-L-9 is camouflage/mimicry. G3-E-2:human-made-objects matches wood as a natural material of human-made things, not a shipworm burrow. Potential G5-L-9 after a lining-as-adaptation, or a wood-borer ecology facet.

Cigarette tar sticks in the lungs and slowly turns them black. G5-L-2 lungs facet requires lung+oxygen+blood/CO2 together and is not admitted; the card does not describe how nose/windpipe/lungs work. G4-L-1 respiratory is not admitted (needs digestive/respiratory how-they-work patterns). G4-M-4:new-properties matches smoke as a burning product, not lung pathology. Potential G5-L-2 after lung-function/harm, or a tobacco-health facet.

Tardigrades likely live in Philippine damp moss/lichen. G4-L-3 needs a habitat-classification diagram. G4-L-4 needs a habitat organism table. G6-L-7 never frames moss as biotic or moisture as abiotic. G5-L-4:nonflowering-plants matches moss as a plant group, not tardigrade habitat. Potential G6-L-7 after biotic/abiotic moss-moisture, or G4-L-4 after a moss-habitat list.

2007 tardigrades survived space vacuum and radiation (TARDIS/FOTON-M3 is a real result). G3-L-3 is grow/respond/reproduce. G7-L-3 is unicellular vs multicellular. G7-M-3:spaces matches space as particle spacing, different referent. G7-F-9:radiation is heat-transfer radiation, not ionizing space radiation. G9-F-10:space|vacuum is a different physics context. Potential new extremophile facet; no G3–10 core covers tardigrade space survival.

Tarictic hornbill lives only in the Philippines. G4-L-3 needs a habitat diagram. G5-L-4 needs a classification table. G3-L-2 is living vs non-living. G6-L-4:local matches Philippin but is vertebrate vs invertebrate. Potential G9-L-6 after endemic/threatened classification, or G6-L-4 after a hornbill vertebrate example.

Tarsiers call at pitches people can barely hear. G3-F-4 is how sound is made/transferred (bell/noises). G6-F-6 needs amplitude/frequency/wavelength/velocity from secondary sources. G3-F-8 is people sending messages with sound. G4-F-8/F-10 sound is action-at-a-distance or home/school sound-energy uses, not ultrasonic animal calls. G6-L-4:local is vertebrate/invertebrate. Potential G6-F-6 after frequency/pitch, or a communication/sense-organ facet.

Each tarsier eye is about as big as its brain, so it must turn its whole head to look around. G3-L-4 needs outer parts' role in movement/feeding; looking around is vision, not those roles. G3-E-9:eye-protection is sun-safety. G3-F-7:bright-light is harmful bright light. G6-L-4:local is backbone grouping. Potential G3-L-4 after eyes/head-as-body-part, or a nocturnal-vision adaptation facet (G5-L-9 currently only camouflage/mimicry).

Tarsier sits still then pounces on an insect. G3-L-4 never names outer parts. G4-L-6 does not group carnivores. G3-L-7 does not explain interdependence for basic needs. G6-L-6 predation is not admitted (no predat|prey). G5-L-4:insects is a classification table. G6-L-4:local is vertebrate/invertebrate. Potential G6-L-6 after predation, or G4-L-6 after carnivore grouping.

Tarsier is nocturnal: awake at night, sleeps by day. G5-L-9 is camouflage/mimicry. G3-L-3 is grow/respond/reproduce. G3-E-6/E-8 day-night/nighttime are guided sky observation and how sky objects affect people, not animal activity cycles. G6-L-4:local is vertebrate/invertebrate. Potential G5-L-9 after nocturnal adaptation, or a diel-activity facet.

Taste buds sit in the visible bumps on the tongue. G5-L-1 digestive parts are mouth/gullet/stomach/intestines from pictures/diagrams, not papillae. G4-L-1 body-systems how-they-work is not admitted. G3-L-4:feeding matches tongue as an animal feeding part, not human taste anatomy. Potential new sense-organ/taste facet (same gap as tongue-five-basic-tastes).

Food tastes bland with a stuffy nose because taste and smell work together. G4-L-1 lists muscular/skeletal/digestive/circulatory/respiratory, not chemosenses. G8-L-2 needs models of systems working together (digestion/excretion). G5-L-2:nose is respiratory how-the-nose-works, not olfaction. Potential new taste/smell sense-organ facet, or G5-L-2 after nasal-olfaction.

Five kingdoms: Animalia, Plantae, Fungi, Protista, Monera. MATATAG G8-L-6 is the six-kingdom and three-domain systems and their importance; five-kingdom/Monera is the older Whittaker scheme and G8-L-6:six-kingdoms is not admitted. G5-L-4:fungi is a classification table of living-thing groups, not kingdoms of life. Potential G8-L-6 after six-kingdom/three-domain (not five).

TB can attack bones, brain, or kidneys besides lungs. G4-L-1 and G5-L-2 do not describe extra-pulmonary TB; G5-L-2 lungs facet is not admitted. No communicable-disease core among candidates. Potential new TB/infectious-disease facet, or G5-L-2 after lung-disease.

Rest and food help TB but only proper medicine kills the bacteria. G7-L-3 is unicellular/multicellular, not disease treatment. G5-L-4:bacteria is a classification table. G7-F-2:rest is balanced forces. Potential TB-treatment/infectious-disease facet, or G5-L-4 after bacteria-as-pathogen (not currently taught).

TB diagnosed by sputum test or chest X-ray. No diagnostic-test core. G5-L-2 is respiratory anatomy. Investigation facets (G4-F-1:guided, G6-F-3:test, G9-M-11:focus-5) are unrelated lab/fair-test matches on test. Potential new disease-diagnosis facet.

TB most often attacks the lungs, making breathing hard and causing cough. G5-L-2 lungs facet needs lung+oxygen+blood/CO2 and is not admitted; the card does not identify nose/windpipe/lungs or how they work. G4-L-1 respiratory is not admitted. Potential G5-L-2 after lung-function/disease.

TB signs: long-lasting cough, fever, weight loss. G5-L-2 is respiratory parts. G10-L-1 homeostasis indicators are temperature/glucose/blood pressure, not TB symptoms. G4-E-8:length matches long as shadow length. Potential infectious-disease-symptoms facet.

Used tears drain through a corner hole into the nose, so the nose runs when you cry. G4-L-1/G5-L-2 are body/respiratory systems, not lacrimal drainage. G5-L-2:nose is breathing, not nasolacrimal flow. G3-E-9:eye-protection is sun-safety. Potential new eye/lacrimal sense-organ facet.

Cutting onion releases a sharp gas; extra tears wash it away. G3-L-3 is grow/respond/reproduce, not a tear reflex. G3-M-8:cutting is making solids useful by cutting. G3-M-7:handling is material safety (sharp/glass). G3-E-9:eye-protection is sun-safety. G6-E-4:gases is volcanic gases. Potential new eye-reflex/sense-organ facet.

Earth's surface is broken into slowly moving tectonic plates. G8-E-6 needs lithosphere/crust-mantle or oceanic vs continental crust and is not admitted. G9-E-3 needs divergent/convergent/transform boundaries and is not admitted. G6-E-1:formation matches plate but is how volcanoes form, not plate motion itself. G10-E-5 (slab pull/ridge push/asthenosphere) is not admitted. Potential G6-E-1 after plates-building-volcanoes, or G8-E-6/G9-E-3 after crust/boundary teaching.

Tooth enamel is the hardest body part and protects the soft inside. G4-L-1 skeletal needs bone.*(support|protect) and is not admitted; enamel is not bone. G3-M-5:hardness needs hard.*(press|scratch|shape)|soft as solid-material properties, not tooth tissue. G4-F-1 rigid/soft is moving/changing rigid vs soft objects. Potential G4-L-1 after teeth/skeletal-protect, or G3-M-5 after enamel-as-hard-material.

Bell's first telephone words: 'Mr. Watson, come here, I want to see you.' History-of-invention trivia. G4-M-1 needs a famous scientist and their invention from secondary sources; the card quotes first words, not identifying Bell as inventor or using sources (invent is not admitted). G3-F-8:sound is people sending messages, not telephone history. G3-F-5:uses matches see inside the quotation. Potential G4-M-1 after Bell-as-inventor, or G4-M-2 after everyday telephone impact.

Temperature is a measure of how hot or cold something is. G7-F-8 (heat vs temperature; heat transfer / particle kinetic) is assigned prerequisite_only and the temperature facet is not admitted. G4-E-4:temperature is air temperature as a weather characteristic, not a general definition. G7-M-3:temperature is particles moving faster with heat. Potential G7-F-8 after a temperature-definition facet, or G4-E-4 after weather-air-temperature.

SI temperature unit is the kelvin, named for Lord Kelvin. G7-M-7:units is measuring with meter/gram/second/liter in an investigation, not naming kelvin. G4-M-1 is a famous scientist and their invention, not a unit namesake. G4-E-4:temperature is weather air temperature. Potential G7-M-7 after kelvin, or G7-F-8 after SI temperature.

Termite colonies have a king who stays with the queen inside the nest. No social-insect/caste core. G3-L-3/G3-L-7 do not teach grow/respond/reproduce or interdependence via a king/queen fact. Time/rate keyword swallows (G6-E-10, G8-F-7, G9-E-5) match long time. Potential new social-insect/caste facet.

Termites live in huge cooperative colonies. G3-L-7 is dependence for basic needs, not eusociality. G6-L-6 is competition/predation from secondary sources. G8-L-4:generations is Mendelian family/pedigree. Potential new social-insect facet, or G3-L-7 after colony-interdependence.

Termites eat paper/cardboard because those are wood cellulose too. G4-L-6 does not group feeders. G3-L-7:food-and-shelter matches eat without teaching basic-need dependence. G3-E-2/G4-M-4/G4-F-7 match wood as material, not cellulose diet. Potential G4-L-6 after decomposer/consumer grouping, or G6-L-5 after decomposers.

Termites eat wood from the inside so it looks solid but is hollow/weak. G6-L-5 decomposers is not admitted. G6-L-8 living-interactions (mutual/parasit/predat/compet) is not admitted. G4-L-6 is herbivore/carnivore/omnivore grouping. G4-M-4:burning matches wood as fuel. Potential G6-L-5 after termite-as-decomposer, or G6-L-8 after wood-eating harm.

Termites are not ants: thick waist vs pinched waist ('white ants' misnomer). G5-L-4 needs a classification table of living-thing groups, not a waist comparison. Time-tracking swallows match 'sometimes'/'time' poorly. Potential G5-L-4 after insect classification characters, or a social-insect ID facet.

An oven as a kitchen device that uses heat to bake/roast/cook, making meal preparation faster and easier, is a current G4-M-2 uses teaching (science invention and everyday impact) and a G4-F-10 heat-energy use at home. Only G4-M-2:uses and G4-F-10:heat are admitted; G4-M-2:community (home|community) and G4-F-10 light/sound are not. Rejected: G4-F-9 names heat but never teaches energy-as-cause-of-change; G7-F-9:advantage matches cook without conduction/convection/radiation; G3-M-1:cook is generic everyday-science. Card cat g4-matter-scientists-and-inventions is the direct G4-M-1/M-2 subcategory, not enrichment. TL/BIS keep oven/bake/roast; init/luto meaning OK. Single identical card in both pools.

evidence.quote: uses heat to bake, roast, or cook food, making meal preparation faster and easier
uses heat to bake, roast, or cook food

originalProposals.reason: Metal fillings expand/contract more than enamel, causing tooth pain with hot/cold food. No thermal-expansion core is admitted. G7-M-3 is particle motion with temperature, not bulk expansion. G4-M-4 is property changes when wood/coal burn. Potential new thermal-expansion/contraction facet, or G7-M-3 after macroscopic expansion.

Repeated metal expansion/contraction loosens electrical sockets, so electricians retighten them. Same missing thermal-expansion core as the filling card. G7-M-3 is particles, not bulk metal. BIS mixes Tagalog pagkikimay into Cebuano. Potential new thermal-expansion facet. Hold also for that translation mix if later recovered.

Thermometer liquid expands and rises when warmer. G7-M-3 is particle motion, not bulk expansion. G7-F-10:convection matches rise but convection is bulk fluid driven by density, not confined liquid expansion in a capillary. G4-F-10:heat is sources/uses of heat energy, not how a thermometer works. G4-M-2:uses does not explain everyday impact of an invention. Potential thermal-expansion facet, or G7-F-8 after temperature-measurement.

Thermos walls block heat from escaping into cooler air. G7-F-9 requires named conduction/convection/radiation examples and only the advantage facet is admitted (not those processes). G4-F-10:heat is sources/uses of heat energy; a thermos retains heat rather than serving as a heat source/use like a stove. G4-F-9 never teaches energy-causes-change. Potential G7-F-9 after an insulator/vacuum-wall example.

Thermosphere is hot with thin air; ISS orbits there, auroras form, exosphere fades to space. No atmospheric-layer core among candidates. G7-E-9 is Sun-atmosphere absorb/reflect/warm, not named layers. G7-M-3:spaces matches space as particle spacing. Potential new atmosphere-layers facet.

Cebu flowerpecker, endemic, thought extinct ~60 years then rediscovered in the 1990s. G9-L-6 IUCN labels are not admitted (no critically endangered/endangered/vulnerable). G9-L-7:extinct matches the word but the competency is discussing how threats cause extinction, not a rediscovery anecdote. G8-E-3:activity matches extinct as a volcano-activity class. Potential G9-L-6 after IUCN classification, or G9-L-7 after habitat-loss threats.

Eggplant, tomato, and okra grow easily in warm Philippine backyards/pots, so families plant them. G3-L-8:care-actions matches plant but the competency is a need to protect/conserve the environment, not backyard food gardening. G3-M-1:local-examples matches plant as everyday science without a science explanation. G3-L-3:grow is grow as a living-thing characteristic. G4-L-4 needs a habitat organism table. Potential G3-L-8 after planting-as-care, or G6-E-6 after seasonal planting.

Wait ~30 minutes after the last thunder because lightning can still strike is a genuine G3-E-5 danger component (some weather is dangerous) and a G4-E-6 safety-precaution component (extreme-weather safety). Only G3-E-5:danger and G4-E-6:safety are admitted; G3-E-5:activities and G4-E-6:chart are not, so no weather-chart hijack. Rejected lightning⊃light swallows: G3-F-8, G4-F-8, G4-F-9, G4-F-10, G5-F-5, G6-L-7, G6-F-9. G5-E-10 before/after is tropical-cyclone weather, not thunderstorm wait-time. NOAA 30/30 wait-30-minutes half is accurate. TL uses bagyo for the passing storm (broader than thunderstorm) but wait-after-kulog/kidlat is intact; BIS dalugdog/kilat/unos meaning OK. Single identical card in both pools.

evidence.quote: Lightning can still strike even after the storm seems to pass
Lightning can still strike even after the storm seems to pass

originalProposals.reason: Thyroid in the neck controls metabolism; excess hormone speeds the body, deficit slows it. G10-L-1 homeostasis indicators are temperature/glucose/blood pressure. G8-L-2 needs models of systems working together. G10-L-2 is not admitted among matching units as a genuine endocrine teaching. Fast/slow matches are motion graphs (G4-F-4/F-5). Potential new endocrine/thyroid facet, or G10-L-1 after metabolic-rate.

Between high tides, water drops elsewhere — low tide exposes more shore. G8-E-11 (Earth-Moon-Sun motions and tides) is related_only and not admitted (needs gravit/spring tide/neap). G7-E-7:coastal-impact matches shore but is earthquake-generated tsunami devastation. G3-F-1:pull is making objects move. Potential G8-E-11 after high/low-tide as the observable, or G8-E-11:gravity after naming gravitational pull.

Moon pulls on seawater, raising and lowering it as high and low tides. G8-E-11 is assigned prerequisite_only and gravity/spring/neap facets are not admitted ('pulls' ≠ gravit). G5-F-4 gravity-as-non-contact is not admitted. G3-E-6:moon is guided sky observation. G8-F-9:gravity is falling-energy conservation. BIS 'Gihagit sa bulan ang tubig' uses hagit (challenge/provoke), not pull (hila/bira) — meaning error relative to EN/TL hinihila. Potential G8-E-11 after moon-gravity; repair BIS before any recovery.
